verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is a SaaS product that holds customer business data, so whether that data can be kept out of AI training is a fair privacy question. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training use, opt-out controls, or a data-usage policy. The security claims (PCI-DSS compliance, SSL encryption, two-factor authentication) cover a related but different subject and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
